children: Macquarie maintained their Outperform rating on MGM Resorts International's stock with a price target of $48.00.
The price target implies an upside of 63.3% from the Oct 13 close of $29.40.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: MGM Resorts International's BetMGM has demonstrated significant growth, with net revenue increasing by 7% year-over-year and EBITDA more than doubling. This solid performance underscores the effectiveness of their disciplined capital allocation and focus on high-value customers, which are driving sustainable profitability and cash generation.

: Despite competitive pressures and challenges in the Vegas market, industry fundamentals remain robust. MGM's strategic emphasis on exclusive content and lower customer acquisition costs positions the company for continued profitable growth, reinforcing Macquarie's positive outlook and Outperform rating on the stock.
